metadata.headline: prompting ceiling: no internal knob survives the pre-registered rules; top of fronts -> entropy: prompt_ban3; offmenu_correct_share: prompt_ban3; outside_menu_correct_share: baseline; entropy_pass: pr...

H-probe.reason: no eligible setting at matched pass rate

manipulation_checks.note: probes trained on baseline mean(gen1..32) residuals; applied to residuals captured DURING steered generation (post-intervention, mean gen1..32). menu_entropy = entropy (bits) of probe softmax restrict...

ban3_text.T1: Do not use any of the following algorithms: breadth-first search (BFS), depth-first search (DFS), Dijkstra's algorithm.
ban3_text.T3: Do not use any of the following algorithms: Dijkstra's algorithm, breadth-first search (BFS), SPFA (queue-based Bellman-Ford).

probe_curve.prompt_final_note: prefill is deterministic, so the prompt-final residual is identical for all samples of a task: a within-task probe there is at the majority baseline by construction

calibration.rule: alpha_lo = largest grid alpha with pass >= 0.95*baseline; alpha_hi = smallest larger alpha with pass <= 0.40*baseline (else grid max); 5 strengths geometric in [alpha_lo, alpha_hi]; frozen before the ...

rules.eligibility: pass_rate >= 0.8 * baseline pass_rate (per task; pooled T1+T3 for decisions)
rules.selection: best-of-method = eligible setting with highest target metric on indices 0..99; survival decided on fresh seeds 1000..1099 (held-out draw) to remove winner's-curse bias
rules.H: entropy(best H) >= 2 x entropy(best eligible temperature) on held-out AND bootstrap 95% CI of entropy(H) - entropy(R-add at same alpha) excludes 0; checked on T1 and pooled, T3 reported
rules.A3: outside_menu_correct_share(best A3) >= 3 x max over (temperature, new, novel2000, ban3) AND >= 0.05 absolute AND CI vs R-proj excludes 0
rules.A4: Spearman(alpha in {0,a1..a5}, atypicality) >= 0.8 on BOTH T1 and T3, atypicality = mean -log p0(label) with add-0.5 smoothing, AND beats R-add at top strength (CI excludes 0)
rules.fallback: if nothing survives: headline = prompting ceiling, naming the prompt method atop each front

heldout_plan.note: best-of-method on indices 0..99 among eligible settings (pass >= 0.8 x baseline, pooled); held-out fresh seeds 1000..1099

params.note: plain T=0.7 re-generated in mixed batches
